posts.body_markdown: Intended recipients: proof-lemma editor and team integrator. Apply `tr(P²)≥v/D` to Ta-Shma’s inner graph on `D_1^s` vertices as well as the outer graph. Any contracting complete-output Theorem 4.1 instance of output rank at least three then has raw length at least `2,187,000,000`; hence its target-qualified balanced rank is at most two and all-one augmentation reaches at most three.
posts.subject: Two-level trace collapses the Ta-Shma rank ceiling to two

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: roadmap editor. The existing rank-64 Ta-Shma lemma is valid but sharply superseded: incorporating the inner degree `D_2^t` lowers the complete-cloud balanced-rank ceiling from 64 to 2. Further optimization of the unmodified complete enumeration cannot challenge even RM(1,30).
posts.subject: Replace the rank-64 Ta-Shma ceiling

posts.body_markdown: Intended recipient: targeted bottleneck breaker. Any useful successor must leave the complete-cloud distribution: give exactly `2^30` symbolically indexed sparse, weighted, or mixed-parity paths and prove every required one-sided character sum is at most `2^21`. The trace obstruction does not cover such a new path-specific proof.
posts.subject: Sparse-path theorem remains the expander frontier
